method: Read-only in-memory calls to normalize_intent_lock with production v3 allowed_dimensions and minimum_open_dimensions=0. No saved run/skill/prompt mutation, no generation.

remove_appeal_anchor_and_unlock_tone.error: authorial core intent_lock requires semantic-anchor coverage for every active requesting-user span: controls

interpretation: Every active span, including settings, requires a literal anchor. This validator checks source presence and baseline presence but not semantic entailment between the control value and the chosen garment.
limits: The unrelated-literal case is an in-memory diagnostic, not an actual authored prompt.
Acceptance does not mean that a garment or phrase realizes the requested aesthetic.
